record.field: purpose: SaltStack operations — ping, diagnosis (pillar/grains/minion/service/disk/memory/load/journal/process) and remediation (state.apply/highstate, cmd.run, service.restart, minion-accept) when: all work against Salt minions — troubleshooting and remediation when not: for Zabbix data (use the zabbix capability); for Odoo/web (other tools) example: {"operation": "salt_test_ping", "minion": "gw*"} then {"operation": "salt_service_status", "minion": "gw1", "service": "caddy"} output: per operation — see the respective operation description guardrail: remediation operations (state.apply, highstate, cmd.run, service.restart, minion_accept) require human approval; read operations run without

field.name: member_ids
field.eval: [(6, 0, [ ref('tool_salt_test_ping'), ref('tool_salt_state_show_sls'), ref('tool_salt_pillar_get'), ref('tool_salt_pillar_items'), ref('tool_salt_grains_get'), ref('tool_salt_grains_items'), ref('tool_salt_minion_list'), ref('tool_salt_service_status'), ref('tool_salt_disk_usage'), ref('tool_salt_memory_usage'), ref('tool_salt_system_load'), ref('tool_salt_journal_errors'), ref('tool_salt_process_list'), ref('tool_salt_state_apply'), ref('tool_salt_state_highstate'), ref('tool_salt_cmd_run'), ref('tool_salt_service_restart'), ref('tool_salt_minion_accept'), ])]

record.field: purpose: Zabbix monitoring — alerts, problems, host, metrics, triggers, host groups and acknowledgment when: all work against Zabbix — drift alerts, trend analysis, acknowledgment after remediation when not: for SaltStack data (use the salt capability) example: {"operation": "zabbix_get_alerts", "severity": "high"} then {"operation": "zabbix_get_problems", "host": "gw1"} then {"operation": "zabbix_acknowledge", "event_id": "123", "message": "Restarted caddy"} output: per operation — see the respective operation description guardrail: zabbix_acknowledge requires human approval (write — changes alert status); read operations run without

field.name: member_ids
field.eval: [(6, 0, [ ref('tool_zabbix_get_alerts'), ref('tool_zabbix_get_host'), ref('tool_zabbix_get_problems'), ref('tool_zabbix_get_history'), ref('tool_zabbix_get_item'), ref('tool_zabbix_get_host_groups'), ref('tool_zabbix_get_triggers'), ref('tool_zabbix_acknowledge'), ])]

record.field: purpose: Backup operations — Borg to disk (LXD hosts → tull1, per artifact) and Restic to S3 (customer Garage buckets → <customer>-backup) when: backup drift, missed nightly runs, retention/prune/pin, restore of one artifact or one customer bucket, "is the backup fresh?" when not: for general host health (use the salt capability); for monitoring symptoms (use zabbix) example: {"operation": "borg_status", "minion": "fors"} then {"operation": "borg_restore", "minion": "fors", "artifact": "containers/sparv", "target": "/tmp/restore-sparv"} output: per operation — see the respective operation description guardrail: read operations run without approval; borg_backup_run, borg_prune (dry_run=false), borg_pin and borg_restore (dry_run=false) require human approval

field.name: member_ids
field.eval: [(6, 0, [ ref('tool_borg_status'), ref('tool_borg_artifacts'), ref('tool_borg_list'), ref('tool_restic_status'), ref('tool_restic_restore_list'), ref('tool_borg_backup_run'), ref('tool_borg_prune'), ref('tool_borg_pin'), ref('tool_borg_restore'), ref('tool_restic_restore'), ])]
